cues.en: Instructor: One of the benefits of being enrolled in this course is that you get access to the Q&A forum, the question answer forum, here on Udemy.
cues.zh: 報名這門課的一個好處，是可以使用 Udemy 這裡的問與答討論區。

cues.en: It's a really great resource.
cues.zh: 這真的是很棒的資源。

cues.en: It can supplement the material that I've put into the lectures.
cues.zh: 它可以補充我放進講座的教材。

cues.en: And the longer the course goes on, the better the Q&A forum gets, because more people are asking and answering questions.
cues.zh: 而且課程開設越久，問與答就越豐富，因為有更多人提問與回答。

cues.en: So in this video, I want to take a moment just to guide you, to give you some pointers for how to use and post a question to the Q&A forum in order to maximize
cues.zh: 這部影片，我想花點時間給你一些指引，說明如何使用問與答、發問，讓你得到最大的，

cues.en: the benefit, not only for you, but also for other students.
cues.zh: 收穫，同時也讓其他學生受益。

cues.en: So if you have a question about the video, the content in the video, the first thing you should do is look through the Q&A for other people who might have asked
cues.zh: 如果對影片或影片內容有問題，首先應該先查看問與答，看看其他人是否問過，

cues.en: a similar question.
cues.zh: 類似問題。

cues.en: And if you don't find that answer, then post a new question, and make sure you're as specific as possible with your question.
cues.zh: 如果找不到答案，再發新問題，而且問題一定要盡可能具體。

cues.en: So if you just post to the Q&A and say, "I didn't understand this video."
cues.zh: 如果只是在問與答寫：「我看不懂這部影片。」

cues.en: Well, I'm probably going to either just throw back the question to you and I'll say, "What didn't you understand?"
cues.zh: 那我大概會把問題丟回給你，問：「哪裡看不懂？」

cues.en: Or, if I'm busy and there's a lot of other questions, I might even just completely ignore your question and not even respond to it.
cues.zh: 或者，如果我很忙，還有很多其他問題，甚至可能完全忽略你的問題，不作回答。

cues.en: So how can you be specific, to get a good answer from me, or from other students?
cues.zh: 所以，怎麼具體提問，才能得到我或其他學生的好答案？

cues.en: For one thing, you can refer to a specific timestamp in the video.
cues.zh: 其中一個方法，是指出影片的特定時間點。

cues.en: So you can say, you know, "At minute, timestamp 6:30, I didn't understand this point can you please clarify?"
cues.zh: 例如：「在 6 分 30 秒，我不明白這一點，能請你解釋嗎？」

cues.en: And try to be specific with your question, if you just say, "I didn't get it", then that's also not going to yield a very good answer.
cues.zh: 問題要盡可能具體。如果只說「我不懂」，也不會得到很好的答案。

cues.en: If you say what you thought, how you think it should work, and why you're confused, that's going to help me give you a better answer.
cues.zh: 如果說明你的想法、認為應該如何運作，以及困惑的原因，會幫助我給出更好的答案。

cues.en: Now, what I'd like to do, is show you how this works in practice.
cues.zh: 現在，我想實際示範操作方式。

cues.en: So here we are on the Udemy screen.
cues.zh: 這是 Udemy 畫面。

cues.en: This is for my linear algebra course, but all the courses look the same.
cues.zh: 這是我的線性代數課，但所有課程看起來都一樣。

cues.en: So here we see the videos on the right, here's the player here.
cues.zh: 右邊是影片清單，這裡是播放器。

cues.en: Here, you know, you can change the runtime speed if you like.
cues.zh: 如果需要，可以在這裡調整播放速度。

cues.en: And now, by default, it's gonna have this tab open, Overview.
cues.zh: 預設會開啟這個「總覽」分頁。

cues.en: And what we care about here is the Q&A tab.
cues.zh: 我們要看的是「問與答」分頁。

cues.en: Now, by default, it's gonna show you all of the questions that have been posed in this entire course.
cues.zh: 預設會顯示整門課中提出的所有問題。

cues.en: But in fact, what we, what is most relevant for you, is going to be to select current lecture.
cues.zh: 但對你最有用的，是選擇「目前的講座」。

cues.en: So then you're just seeing the questions that are in this specific lecture, that other people have asked about this lecture.
cues.zh: 這樣就只會看到其他人針對這堂特定講座提出的問題。

cues.en: So it's interesting just to click on these and go through other people's questions.
cues.zh: 點進去看看別人的問題，很有意思。

cues.en: You can see my answers, other students' answers.
cues.zh: 可以看到我的回答，以及其他學生的回答。

cues.en: Here you can search for questions, to see if your question has already been asked.
cues.zh: 這裡能搜尋問題，看看你的問題是否已經有人問過。

cues.en: And if that is not the case, if your question isn't already there, then you click here, ask a new question, and most likely it's gonna be about course content.
cues.zh: 如果沒有，你的問題還不存在，就點這裡「提出新問題」，大多數情況會是關於課程內容。

cues.en: So then we continue.
cues.zh: 接著繼續。

cues.en: And now, here we can write a title.
cues.zh: 現在可以在這裡寫標題。

cues.en: And the title is useful for me, it helps me, it helps other students know what this question is going to be about.
cues.zh: 標題對我有幫助，也能幫助其他學生知道這個問題的主題。

cues.en: So it's good to make the title be as specific as possible.
cues.zh: 所以標題最好盡可能具體。

cues.en: Maybe you say, "Question about dot product with column vectors."
cues.zh: 例如：「關於欄向量內積的問題」。

cues.en: So this is, you know, this is just relevant for this particular video that I have here.
cues.zh: 這只是針對我現在這部影片相關的例子。

cues.en: And then here is the details.
cues.zh: 接著是詳細內容。

cues.en: This is where you write your actual question.
cues.zh: 在這裡寫下實際的問題。

cues.en: And you can already see that Udemy is priming you, to give a timestamp, which is great, and attach a screenshot, which is great.
cues.zh: 可以看到，Udemy 已經提示你提供時間點，這很好，也提示附上螢幕截圖，這也很好。

cues.en: You can include a screenshot here using the image button.
cues.zh: 可以用這裡的圖片按鈕加入截圖。

cues.en: So this will allow you to either just drag an image on here or select it from your computer.
cues.zh: 可以直接把圖片拖進來，或從電腦選取。

cues.en: And the other thing I want to note here, is that, if you're writing code, if you wanna send me some code, then use this code formatting tool here.
cues.zh: 另外要注意，如果你在寫程式，想把程式碼傳給我，請使用這裡的程式碼格式工具。

cues.en: So, there's two ways to use this code formatting tool.
cues.zh: 這個程式碼格式工具有兩種用法。

cues.en: One is inline code formatting.
cues.zh: 第一種是行內程式碼格式。

cues.en: So you can say, "I have a question about the variable called asdf."
cues.zh: 例如可以說：「我對名為 asdf 的變數有問題。」

cues.en: And yes, I realize this is misspelled.
cues.zh: 對，我知道這裡拼錯了。

cues.en: Now let's say this is a variable name, or it's a little piece of code, so I'm going to select it, highlight it here, and do this.
cues.zh: 假設這是一個變數名稱，或一小段程式碼，我選取、反白後，按這個。

cues.en: So now this looks really great.
cues.zh: 現在看起來很棒。

cues.en: This helps me know that this is a variable.
cues.zh: 這能幫助我知道它是個變數。

cues.en: You can also have multi-line code.
cues.zh: 也能放多行程式碼。

cues.en: So for example, let's say, for I-1:3, and I don't know, disp(i), it's not terribly interesting code, but just to give you an example.
cues.zh: 例如，for i=1:3，然後，disp(i)。這不是多有趣的程式碼，只是舉個例子。

cues.en: So I highlight all of these lines, press this again, and now we get this really beautifully formatted code.
cues.zh: 把所有這些行反白，再按一次，就得到漂亮排版的程式碼。

cues.en: Please, please, please format your code using the code format tool.
cues.zh: 拜託，請一定要用程式碼格式工具來排版。

cues.en: This really helps me when I need to copy and paste this into MATLAB or Python.
cues.zh: 我需要把內容複製貼到 MATLAB 或 Python 時，這真的很有幫助。

cues.en: The final thing I wanna mention here is that the Q&A is not only your opportunity to ask questions of me, it's also your opportunity to interact and help out
cues.zh: 最後要提的是，問與答不只是向我提問的機會，也是你與其他同學互動、幫助，

cues.en: your fellow students.
cues.zh: 其他同學的機會。

cues.en: So if you see other students posting questions and you know an answer, or you guess an answer, you want to contribute to the Q&A, that's really great.
cues.zh: 如果看到其他學生發問，而你知道答案，或猜得出答案，想參與問與答，真的很棒。

cues.en: I really appreciate it, the students really appreciate it, and it's a nice way for us together, to build a little community inside this course.
cues.zh: 我非常感謝，其他學生也會很感謝。這是讓我們一起在課程內建立小社群的好方式。
